name: Coding Jobs
_setup_notes: Import this file into n8n via Settings → Import workflow.
Required nodes to configure after import:
1. Webhook or Todoist Trigger — triggered by task label 'code' or direct webhook
2. HTTP Request (LiteLLM risk check) — assess risk level before routing
3. IF node — branch: low-risk local worktree vs high-risk OpenHands sandbox
4a. Low-risk path: HTTP Request → Codex/Claude Code API
4b. High-risk path: HTTP Request → OpenHands API at http://openhands:3000
5. Wait node — approval gate for: package installs, git push, file deletes, external effects
6. Poll / Webhook — monitor job completion from OpenHands
7. Todoist Update Task — add completion comment and close task
8. SQLite Insert — write audit row to db/assistant.db jobs table
All dependency installs, git pushes, and shell commands must go through the sandbox path.
